meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: 'Use tauri like a faster qemu' — the Dentauri node is the fast kernel harness

dentauri_harness.law: Tauri is the faster QEMU: native-speed execution of Kido's hosted path with a real UI, instead of full hardware emulation.

architecture.backend: Tauri's Rust side drives kido_boot() through the hosted build path, providing virtual UART and timer at native speed — no emulation overhead.
architecture.frontend: Deno-powered UI: live console, boot-stage visualization (early → probe → adapt → breath), test results, task-switching view.
architecture.name: Dentauri — Deno + Tauri, one node, one harness.

dentauri_harness.relationship_to_qemu: QEMU proves the bare-metal ARM64 path (still required — emulation is the honest hardware proof). The Dentauri harness proves LOGIC at native speed for fast iteration. Both, not either/or: QEMU for the metal, Dentauri for the mind.
dentauri_harness.mandala: The Dentauri language node represents this harness — its element shows the harness state, and it is the launch surface for fast kernel runs.
dentauri_harness.queue: Harness build starts after the QEMU proof lands — no overlapping builders on the kernel tree.
